name: @sl/security-tests
description: Cross-cutting security tests for The Sniper's Ledger: authz matrix, unauthenticated-access, CSRF, rate-limit/lockout, injection payloads, security headers, mass-assignment, IDOR and webhook-signature checks — run against the real built @sl/api app (buildApp()), never mocks. See README.md for how CI wires these plus pnpm audit / gitleaks / semgrep / CodeQL.
